# S1b job tables (generated by gen/s1gen.py)

Each job: name (set, render_pb_pages P, runner knobs, regtimeline), then the exact tool
command.  The tool is `$T`, staged programs `$S`, the work directory `$W`.  `set`: control,
heldout, replicate.  The table files in `tables/` are the runner's input; this is a view.

## p-b2: 8 jobs, 7 conditions

```
B2 (pixel, S1b item 5): Q200, where the lower-binade deviation region comes from.  Coverage fix
(b2model.py: the clear 1.0 is not covered).  Every job keeps its parameter buffer (--dump-render)
so the stored
(clipped) polygon is read.  HT: the region is fixed in target coordinates (every job's map inside
256 x 128 equals
d-ctl's, d-shift's the d-ctl map on its coverage); HV: it moves with the triangle; HCLIP (S1 post
hoc candidate,
frozen here): the plane is set up from the clipped polygon, so a job deviates iff its stored
polygon is not the
original triangle, and two jobs with the same stored polygon deviate alike.  Target ladder
128/192/256/512 and a
smaller triangle (448, 384) carrying the same dyadic plane (A = 1/8192); d-shift and d-tall repeat
S1's (post hoc: no
deviating pixel).
```

- `d-ctl`: control: dp-ax-b2 (E731; S1 frozen reproduction).  [control, P=-, knobs: stophang]

  ```
  tri --keep-overflow --wait-ms 20000 --width 256 --height 128 --tri-v 0,0,131072,0,0,131072 \
      --tri-z 0.125,0.1875,0.125 --depth --depth-ctl 0x17103c --depth-fill 0xdeadbeef \
      --depth-dump "$W/depth" --depth-pages 48 --poke blk:1=0x00400200 --pixels --dump-render \
      "$W/dump"
  ```

- `d-ctl-r2`: replicate of the control.  [replicate, P=-, knobs: stophang]

  ```
  tri --keep-overflow --wait-ms 20000 --width 256 --height 128 --tri-v 0,0,131072,0,0,131072 \
      --tri-z 0.125,0.1875,0.125 --depth --depth-ctl 0x17103c --depth-fill 0xdeadbeef \
      --depth-dump "$W/depth" --depth-pages 48 --poke blk:1=0x00400200 --pixels --dump-render \
      "$W/dump"
  ```

- `d-shift`: REPEAT of an S1 post-hoc fit: triangle moved (64, 32): HT region fixed, HV moves.
  [repeat, P=-, knobs: stophang expectdiff]

  ```
      0x17103c --depth-fill 0xdeadbeef --depth-dump "$W/depth" --depth-pages 48 --poke \
      blk:1=0x00400200 --pixels --dump-render "$W/dump"
  ```

## g-e8b: 7 jobs, 5 conditions

```
E8b (geometry, S1b item 6): Q073/Q241, a table where HD and HP differ.  S1's six jobs had HD and
HP
predict the same winner everywhere, and the translucent images equal the opaque ones (post hoc).
Here the
translucent object's compare is ALWAYS (ISP0 bits 24:22 = 7, pass type 1: 0x03c00200) and it is
the farther one:
t-2 (translucent second): HD green, HL/HP/HN red; t-1 (translucent first): HP green, HL/HD/HN red.
HN ('pass type
changes nothing', S1 post hoc) predicts as the opaque control o-2-alw-far (list order).  Controls:
S1's two opaque
jobs and o-2-alw-far (an opaque ALWAYS second object draws although farther).
```

## g-e1: 16 jobs, 16 conditions

```
E1 (geometry, S1b item 7): Q273/Q210, where the raise stops below P = 0x3e0.  S1 (post hoc):
raises
at thr0 <= 0x2de, none at thr0 >= 0x3be, for 1350 and 1500 alike.  Here 1350 and 1500 at P = 0x320
.. 0x3c0.  HP1:
one step P for both scenes (raise below a P*, none from P* on, the same P* for both; S1's post-hoc
limit on the raised
threshold, 0x2fe <= C < 0x3de, says the same); HPS: the step differs by scene.  Controls ONLY from
raises and
non-raises already measured under these exact words (S1's design used a held-out prediction as a
control): the
negative c-1500-0x422 and the positive p-1350-0x300.  Knob proof per job: the job's own 0x0624
rows (not the first
sample, which is the previous job's).  s-1350/s-1380 at 0x3e0 repeat S1's dword-36 step (post hoc
2 -> 3).
```

## g-e3: 14 jobs, 14 conditions

```
E3 subset (geometry, S1b item 8): Q230, gated PER GROUP (a group counts only if its own controls
hold).
e3i: the w scan inside the guard band (x, y scaled by w, so no clip-made vertex; S1's w =
1e-3/1e-5 jobs were
clipped, which hid the reciprocal rule), with w where RZ32 and RN32 of 1/w differ.  e3z: the z cut
scored by vertex
identity (S1 post hoc: both cuts are clipped polygons; HC-orig requires the ORIGINAL three).  e3k:
the w clamp; the
control is S1's e3k-ctl predicted as S1 measured it ('replace': an object with 1/w = 1/clamp,
inside 31.5..32.5);
a clamp ladder 1e-5 .. 1e-3 over w = 1e-5 in band: HREP (S1 post hoc) predicts 1/w = 1/clamp and
x, y divided by the
clamp (the triangle shrinks by w/clamp about the centre); HREM the object removed.
```

- `e3i-ctl`: control: in-band program with w = 1 (E651's object, S1 frozen e3c-w1).  [control,
  P=-, knobs: stophang]

  ```
  probe --temps 32 --pixels --tri vtxuse --width 64 --height 64 --dump-render "$W/dump" \
      "$S/e3i-ctl__0.bin"
  ```

## p-c: 17 jobs, 16 conditions

```
C (pixel, S1b item 9): Q276.  The order control c-u runs three times and passes by a FROZEN
criterion
(tag-2 fraction >= 0.98; S1 required exactly 1.0 and saw 0.990: five sources (16,25), (16,27),
(17..19,27) kept the
first write; HCL names that cluster as a hypothesis).  The replicate c-k7-x-rep is compared with
c-k7-x (S1's scorer
dropped it).  HQ (S1 post hoc): the predicate gates o1 per lane, g25 = the pixel's lane in its 2x2
quad: k7 no tag 2,
k0 a quarter all at (even, even) sources, k3 a quarter all at (odd, odd).  g23's HP value is
refrozen from S1's
0.253 (fit data; S1's 0.5 was the generator's guess).  HA, HN as in S1.
```

## g-e4w: 8 jobs, 5 conditions

```
E4w (geometry, S1b item 2): Q112, the positive test of the index width.  Tool change: probe --tri
--index-width 32 writes the index list 0..14 as 32-bit words and sets VDM word 2 bit 25 (the bit
S1's g-e4 left
with a HW signature: over the 16-bit list it faulted 0xd0008, 2 of 2); --vdm 2^=V flips bits after
it.
HW32 (bit 25 selects 32-bit indices): ix32-25 draws E414's object word for word 2 of 2, and ix32-n
(bit 25 cleared
over the 32-bit list: read as 16-bit, indices 0,0,1,0,2,0,...) does not; ix32-2425 'same' or a
hang (bit 24 alone hung
in S1).  HX (bit 25 is something else): ix32-25 faults as the 16-bit job.  Expected hangs and
faults are hypotheses:
every row but ix-c is a hypo row (measured, at most its group's events); ix-25 (the S1 fault, a
control) last.
Knob proof: the probe line's '32-bit indices' and tests/emit_checks.py (the words, with the tool's
mock).
```
